items.title: 2026-08-10 spend $54.06, 4 leads, CPL $13.52
items.summary: Total Meta spend for 2026-08-10 (America/Toronto) was $54.06 CAD across 1 active campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, producing 4 leads at $13.52 CPL. That's below the 7-day baseline CPL of $15.98, so delivery looks healthy. Account status is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: No prior meta-ads.json found in the last 7 days of /ingest — this looks like the first run of this source, so --days 1 (yesterday, 2026-08-10) was pulled per standard cadence rather than widened; there was no prior successful run to measure a gap against.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions include lead-like action types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — all value=4, matching the counted 4 leads today with no evidence of undercount, but the set should be reviewed for whether these need adding).
